rust_summary: item tooltip rendering interception (`native_tooltip_render_pre`), GUI item drawing helpers (`gui_draw_item`, `gui_draw_item_with`), and live keyboard modifier/key state checks (`has_shift_down`, `has_control_down`, `has_alt_down`, `is_key_down`).
doc_summary: `native_tooltip_render_pre(stack, batch, x, y, cancel)` allows cancelling vanilla item tooltip rendering or drawing custom surfaces, while `Host` gains `gui_draw_item(batch, stack, at)`, `gui_draw_item_with(batch, stack, at, text)`, `has_shift_down()`, `has_control_down()`, `has_alt_down()`, and `is_key_down(key)`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:tooltip_render@.
